anti_goal_violations.anti_goal: AG-3: A journey passes ONLY if the displayed numbers are correct — they match the engine's computation for the same as-of date — not merely that the page renders.
anti_goal_violations.evidence: Interrupted backfill rows served a fabricated '0 calendar days · 0 already snapshotted · 0 non-trading' breakdown for ranges that were really hundreds of days (browser-qa UT-14 Additional observation, reproduced twice on 517-day jobs). Found and FIXED intra-iteration by the audit (Finding B1): _run_detail gates the four breakdown fields to null on _breakdown_computed (calendar_days>0), regression-tested. Confirmed in working tree: apps/backend/app/engine/data_manager.py:3017,3032-3035.

anti_goal_violations.anti_goal: AG-3: A journey passes ONLY if the displayed numbers are correct — they match the engine's computation for the same as-of date — not merely that the page renders.
anti_goal_violations.evidence: REVIEW pass-1 CRITICAL: coverage_from_storage regressed the app-wide as-of switcher — selecting an already-ingested historical date served a FALSE all-zero 'not yet computed' sentinel instead of real coverage (only the single current-latest as-of ever had a persisted row). FIXED intra-iteration by dev (two layers: _persist_per_date_coverage_snapshots at ingest for new dates + coverage_from_storage read-path self-heal for legacy explicit as_of, both via the canonical _compute_coverage_uncached). Re-verified: browser-qa UT-05 cross-checked 2015-04-01->360 and 2015-01-16->354 byte-exact vs direct API; 2 regression tests assert symbol_count==1 (REAL) vs 0 sentinel. Review pass-2 = PASS_WITH_NOTES.

anti_goal_violations.anti_goal: AG-3 (dimension): displayed numbers must be correct — a fetch that lands new bars silently blanks the DEFAULT /data coverage panel to false all-zeros.
anti_goal_violations.evidence: Audit Finding B1 + browser-qa 'Additional Finding' (both live-reproduced): CoverageSnapshot rows are keyed on (asof_key, dataset_version); a fetch that lands >=1 bar changes the dataset_version fingerprint, so no current-stamp row matches and the default as_of=None visit (self-heal gated to explicit as_of only, to preserve the TC-6/TC-9 cold-boot no-whole-table guarantee) falls to the honest-empty sentinel — Universe/Symbols/Trading-days all render 0 for a fully-ingested DB until the next restart or backfill/rebuild. Root-caused at data_manager.py:3759 (fetch/expand excluded from finalize hook, correct per scope) + :1101 (self-heal as_of gate) + :900 (sentinel). SCOPED-OUT this iteration ('Any change to fetch/expand kinds finalize behavior' is OUT OF SCOPE; no Must-have journey exercises fetch-then-coverage). NOT loop-halting: breaks no Must-have journey (J-01/J-03/J-04/J-05 all pass their own paths; AG-3 is journey-scoped), self-heals with no data loss, no byte-identity/AG-8/AG-9 violation, disclosed with a clear fix. Audit was genuinely unsure IMPORTANT-vs-CRITICAL and named the higher on the product's AG-3 dimension; audit+QA+ux-regression all classified it a non-blocking follow-up and the audit explicitly recommended 'Proceed'. BLOCKS a future GOAL_ACHIEVED and is the #1 next-step: refresh coverage_snapshot at the end of ANY count-changing ingest kind (ingest-time, AG-8-safe), gated to skip when dataset_version is unchanged; do NOT extend the as_of=None self-heal (would re-introduce the worse cold-boot whole-table compute).
